turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I was poking around that new startup CoupleWork AI this morning and noticed something interesting. Maxine is the AI agent within CoupleWork AI, which seems pretty central to their whole pitch.
That sounds like a core feature. Have you tried using it yet?
Not yet, I'm just reading the docs. Oh, by the way, do you know if it's going to rain this evening? I want to walk the dog.
I don't have real-time weather data, but you can check a local app for the most accurate forecast.
Fair enough. I'll check. Anyway, back to the tech stuff, I need to order some new mechanical switches for my keyboard.
What kind of switches are you looking for?
Maybe the Cherry MX Browns. They have a nice tactile bump.
Good choice. They are quite popular for typing and gaming.
Lloyd, I found a really cool research paper today. Cyrus Clarke is affiliated with MIT Media Lab, and their work on spatial computing is fascinating.
MIT Media Lab does have a strong reputation in that area. What specific aspects did you find interesting?
Just the way they handle user interaction in mixed reality. Speaking of mixed reality, I need to clean my VR headset lenses.
Make sure to use a microfiber cloth to avoid scratching them.
I will. Also, do you remember if we have any leftover Thai food in the fridge?
I don't have access to your fridge inventory, but I hope it's still good!
Haha, I'll check. Thanks for the reminder to check the lenses.
You're welcome. Let me know if you need more info on the paper.
